description: a cone frustum (radius 3 at z = 0, 2 at z = 4, revolved from a section in the xz plane, its seam at +x) and a 2 x 2 x 2 box standing on its top plane, z in 4..6, x in -4..-2, touching the top rim at the single point (-2, 0, 4), which lies inside the rim edge, opposite the seam vertex. Two lumps joined at a vertex, which a manifold solid does not hold: Open CASCADE builds a compound of two solids. Arris refuses Reason::NonManifold naming the touch vertex, as at +x: the touch lies inside the rim edge and the box's edge, from outside both faces, and on a coplanar pair facing apart it is a vertex of both (the retired tangency-faults plan)
